title: K-Pop Meets Digital Fashion: Behind Ae-Aespa’S "Whiplash" Universe 🌐✨[En/Kr/Es/Cn/Jp/Fr/Pt Sub]
description:
Are you a K-pop fan? 🎶 You’ve probably noticed the stunning visuals that make K-pop performances truly next-level. But who brings that magic to life behind the scenes?

Meet Jinbeom and Jon — two talented creators who brought @aespa ae-aespa’s “Whiplash” Universe to life with digital garments that pushed realism and visual impact to the max. 💥✨

Even though they used different tools — Jon with CLO and Jinbeom with Marvelous Designer — they collaborated seamlessly to build ae-aespa’s outfits, showing just how compatible and powerful both software is for digital creation.

Stay inspired and see what happens when creativity meets our technologies! 💡🧵

#kpop #whiplash #aespa #digitalfashion

transcript: Hello, I'm Park Jin-beom, who is working on a visual creative project under the name of TAGIREN. Recently, I worked on the I.E.SPA character artwork for the girl group aespa's Reflash album. Hello, I'm Yon Sanchez, a digital fashion creator and 3D artist. My work focuses on creating clothes that are realistic in visual environments. I worked with Jin-beom on the Reflash Universe project. Two years ago, while preparing an online lecture, I wanted to explain to the students how to make clothes and how to use existing asset clothes. At that time, I was looking for assets to use. At that time, Yon had a lot of professionally and systematically produced clothes, so based on Yon's clothes, I wanted to explain how to customize them to the students. That's when I got in touch with Yon. I think that's when we got into contact. I looked at Jin-beom's Instagram and thought, Okay, this person knows what she's doing. I love her style. I want to work with her. I.E.SPA's character work was uploaded to my SNS on SM Entertainment. I saw the previous character artwork and thankfully contacted the studio. I think it was really good at the time. I always pursued a style that gave me a good opportunity to redesign the I.E.SPA character and design the clothes. It was a very fun project to work on and it was meaningful. At that time, I was in touch with Yon, and I asked him via DM to work on the I.E.SPA costume production together because I know Yon's excellent skills. Jin-beom sent me a direct message asking me about this collaboration. And without thinking much about it, I said, Let's go ahead with it. We connected very quickly. It was very natural. I thought, It can't be better than this. I.E.SPA's collaboration with Yon has been very fluid. Collaborating together has been very fluid. We actively share connections, we give each other mutual feedback, and we help each other a lot. The project had a clear line from the beginning. The process was very fluid. I quickly made the basic structure and then added the details. Yon had previously collaborated with Yon several times. Thanks to this work, we were able to quickly proceed with the project with smooth communication. Thanks to this work, we were able to quickly proceed with the project with smooth communication. Thanks to the improvement of the simulation by GPU of Claw and Marvelous Designer, I think it can work faster and more easily. Especially using Marvelous Designer, we could spend more time on concepts and level of detail, so we were able to create a high-quality artwork. In addition, we were able to work more effectively and efficiently because we collaborated and communicated using Claw and Marvelous Designer. And since the files are compatible, it is much easier to review them. After ISPA's Reflash Universe project, I have been working with other K-pop artists. Besides fashion and entertainment, I want to have a career in the game field as well. My ultimate goal is to become a 3D character artist who is active in various industries in the future. I loved working on the ISPA project. It opened many doors for me to different projects with fashion brands, the automotive industry, and projects where you can always learn something new. I would say it's my daily life. Thanks to this, I can experiment digitally with different forms. I hope to show you my new projects. Right now, I'm mainly dealing with Marvelous Designer. The compatibility between Claw and Marvelous Designer is really good. I know I'm getting better at making a video, but I can see that Claw is the one thing that stood out from the rest of the people. markdown_content: ## Introduction to the Ae-Aespa "Whiplash" Universe Collaboration This section introduces the key creators involved in the Ae-Aespa "Whiplash" Universe project, focusing on digital fashion, 3D character artwork, and the collaborative process that brought the project to life. It highlights the intersection of K-pop, digital fashion design, and advanced 3D tools. Park Jin-beom, working under the name TAGIREN, is a visual creative professional who contributed character artwork for aespa's "Reflash" album. Yon Sanchez is a digital fashion creator and 3D artist specializing in creating realistic clothing for virtual environments. Their collaboration began when Jin-beom sought professional clothing assets to teach students about clothing customization and found Yon’s systematically produced digital garments. The collaboration was initiated through Instagram, where Jin-beom admired Yon’s style and skills. This partnership led to the redesign and production of the I.E.SPA character’s costumes for the Reflash Universe project. The process was described as fluid and natural, with both creators sharing feedback and supporting each other effectively, resulting in a cohesive and high-quality final product. --- ## Tools and Workflow: Claw and Marvelous Designer This section explains the technical tools and workflow used in the digital fashion creation for the project, focusing on the integration of Claw and Marvelous Designer software to enhance efficiency and quality. Claw and Marvelous Designer were pivotal in the creation of the digital garments for the Ae-Aespa project. Marvelous Designer is a 3D garment simulation tool widely used for creating realistic clothing by simulating fabric physics. Claw, another essential tool for Yon, offers digital experimentation with different forms and supports a seamless workflow. The compatibility between Claw and Marvelous Designer was crucial, allowing smooth file exchanges and review processes. The GPU improvements in both tools enhanced the speed and ease of fabric simulation, enabling the team to focus more on conceptual development and detailing rather than technical constraints. This integrated workflow supported rapid prototyping and refinement, allowing for high-quality artwork while maintaining an efficient collaborative process. --- ## Impact and Future Aspirations in Digital Fashion and 3D Art This section covers the professional growth opportunities and future career goals inspired by the Ae-Aespa project, as well as the broader aspirations within the fields of digital fashion, entertainment, and gaming. The success of the Ae-Aespa Reflash Universe project opened new opportunities for the creators, leading to collaborations with other K-pop artists and projects across fashion brands and the automotive industry. The experience provided continuous learning and exposure to various industries. Yon Sanchez expressed ambitions to expand into game development and become a versatile 3D character artist active in multiple sectors. Despite these aspirations, Yon emphasizes a long-term approach focused on ongoing learning, trend awareness, and networking. Additionally, Marvelous Designer is identified as a critical tool for career progression, with continuous use planned to achieve professional goals. Claw remains a daily part of the creative workflow, offering unique advantages in digital experimentation and form exploration. --- ## Summary of Key Technologies: Claw and Marvelous Designer This final section summarizes the technical importance and distinctive features of Claw and Marvelous Designer as used in the Ae-Aespa "Whiplash" Universe. - **Claw**: A digital tool central to the creative process, enabling experimentation with various digital forms and styles. Its integration into the workflow is described as essential and unique compared to other options. - **Marvelous Designer**: A 3D clothing simulation software that realistically replicates fabric physics, allowing designers to focus on detailed conceptual work. Its compatibility with Claw enhances efficiency and quality. Together, these tools facilitate a streamlined, high-fidelity production pipeline for digital fashion design and 3D character costume creation, exemplified in the Ae-Aespa Reflash Universe project.
